name: DDoS Security
description: Application-layer, per-IP request-rate limiting and blocking (hits-per-minute counting) with an admin block/unblock list, CSV/mail reporting, and simple user-agent/URL malicious-request filtering. Not true network-layer DDoS protection.
project_description: DDoS Security (ddos_security) is an application-layer request-throttling module. A KernelEvents::REQUEST subscriber counts each anonymous client IP's hits per minute in a dedicated 'ddos_security' database table; once an IP exceeds the configured hits-per-minute threshold it is marked 'blocked' and redirected to an internal alert page. Administrators can whitelist IPs and paths, review and block/unblock/delete IP entries, export the log as CSV, and optionally receive a mail notification with the report link on cron. It also does light malicious-request filtering (bot/crawler user-agent strings and configurable substrings in the request URL). It is not a network-layer or edge DDoS mitigation; it operates inside the Drupal PHP request lifecycle.
